component.name: Qournal
component.summary: Take handwritten notes and annotate PDF files
Handschriftliche Notizen machen und PDF-Dateien beschriften

description.p: A project of its own, not made by the developers of Xournal++. It reads and writes the files of Xournal++ and offers its tools, written anew on Qt: pen, highlighter, eraser, shapes, text, images, LaTeX formulas, layers, audio recordings and plugins. PDF files can be annotated and exported again.
